research_question: Does the positive edge and execution robustness observed during DEVELOPMENT survive on the reserved VALIDATION period without changing the strategy?

degradation_metrics.avg_r_relative_change: (validation_average_r - development_average_r) / development_average_r when development_average_r is positive and numerically stable

borderline_rules.description: Positive chronology-robust values inside these margins are flagged as marginal rather than treated as precise evidence of a durable edge.

edge_survival.STRONG: EXCLUDED and ENTRY_FIRST average R are positive, both Profit Factors exceed 1, and neither chronology-robust result is inside the predeclared borderline margin.
edge_survival.MIXED: Observed edge remains positive but ENTRY_FIRST fails, or chronology-robust edge survives only inside the predeclared borderline margin.
edge_survival.FAILED: EXCLUDED average R is non-positive or Profit Factor is at most 1 and evidence does not support survival.

degradation.LOW: Validation average R retains at least 75% of positive DEVELOPMENT average R.
degradation.MODERATE: Validation retains at least 50% but less than 75%.
degradation.HIGH: Validation retains more than 0% but less than 50%.

temporal_consistency.positive_month_concentration: best positive month R divided by the sum of positive monthly R; undefined when no month is positive
temporal_consistency.first_half: first three observed VALIDATION calendar months
temporal_consistency.second_half: last three observed VALIDATION calendar months
temporal_consistency.BROAD: Total R is positive, at least 50% of observed months are positive, the best positive month contributes at most 60% of positive monthly R, and the UNSTABLE condition is false.
temporal_consistency.CONCENTRATED: Total R is positive but monthly breadth or the predeclared 60% concentration condition fails, while the UNSTABLE condition is false.
temporal_consistency.UNSTABLE: Total R is non-positive, or the second half is negative and gives back at least 50% of a positive first-half Total R.

observability.STRONG: All scenario average R values and Profit Factors remain above their survival thresholds, ambiguity is below 15% and less than 5 percentage points above DEVELOPMENT, and chronology range is not materially larger than DEVELOPMENT.
observability.CAUTION: Positive edge survives but ambiguity or chronology range breaches a predeclared material-increase condition.
observability.FAILED: ENTRY_FIRST average R is non-positive or ENTRY_FIRST Profit Factor is at most 1.

overall.PASS: Edge survival is STRONG, degradation is LOW or MODERATE, temporal consistency is BROAD, and observability is STRONG.
overall.REVISE: The candidate is not REJECTED but any PASS condition is not met. Any revision must return to DEVELOPMENT as a new strategy version.
overall.REJECT: Edge survival is FAILED or observability is FAILED.

portfolio_role: Candidate comparison only; no combined portfolio or weight optimization.
